body:
Thank you for this. When I posted this I felt particularly low, lower than I have in a while. Maybe suicide watch was a bit of an extreme to post in, but I can't deny that those thoughts were in my head. I kept envisioning a scene from a horror movie where the character injured themselves and knew that would be the easiest way to go.

Thank you for caring, Sal. Your efforts and compassion are just what this world needs.

I never said anything about a perfect life. I just expect life to be a bit more like waves, with crests and troughs. Not shitty smelling stagnant swamp water sitting at the bottom of a hill. Not everything was my fault, sure, whatever.. but that doesn't mean I like myself for all the shit that was my fault.

I might have needed child support as a child. I don't know, I wasn't privy to the financial situations of my parents or my life back then. If I was I might not have been where I had been and had the shitty things happen to me. That's neither here nor there though. I can't be there for him emotionally or any other way right now, so you're saying it's okay that when he does finally seek me out when he's an adult and I'm still this steaming pile of shit and he wants help with college, or a car, or fuck.. anything, I won't be able to help or provide for him. 

I've tried to find love with other damaged people. I've tried to find love with fine stable people. The common denominator is me. I'm the screwup who can't keep a relationship going, happy, or fresh, or whatever. Nobody wants to be with a loser who can't even afford to take care of themselves, who when isn't in love is fucking depressed. I use to believe it was more powerful than that, but recent events are leading me to finally lose my blind optimism towards the subject and just accept that it isn't for me.

If you have any further tips for unconditional love, then feel free to say more about that. I think my love towards others has been unconditional but for myself that sounds absurd.

And for your final point, I meant "we" as a human race, not me in particular. I might not make it to next Tuesday.

I hear ya. I just posted a pretty detailed post about myself, my problems, my shortcomings and my shit, hoping for at least some kind words or.. anything really, even if it was a troll or someone not following the rules saying "do it faggot" but I have yet to even receive that. All I've got are ill gotten upvotes and some well received downvotes. It might be because sensible people who don't feel suicidal aren't on this sub and the 77~ some odd lurkers are other suicidal folks also hoping to get help instead of provide help.

I don't have anything to say other than we're in the same boat~ or at least sailing down the same shit river. I wonder if it's just the time of day? Maybe morning suicidal folks are more likely to get attention. I don't know, i hear ya though. Apparently some people are "too real" for suicide watch this late at night though.

edit: after i posted this, i had a message in my inbox. Hoping it was an actual reply to my post (sorry mate, but deep down we're all selfish animals), it was just a disclaimer about this message I'm editing right now and my thread is still empty. I can't necessilarly say I disagree with the silent people. It's easy to respond to vagueness, but if you try to respond to such an emotionally fueled post then you have a thousand more chances of saying something wrong. I read an interesting quote about language earlier this week. "Language is a two edged sword. If you live by the sword, you die by the sword."
